name: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds

description.value:
At combat start and your turn start, randomly grant the party attack bonus +1, critical damage bonus +2, or Energy Regeneration score +1 until your next turn. Do not repeat the previous result. Ends if you fall unconscious.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching harmony Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
